tur14-78: Walking requires your muscles, joints, balance, heart, lungs and nervous system to work together. That is why walking speed is used as a simple marker of overall health in older adults. In an analysis combining nine studies that followed 34,485 people aged 65 and over, those who walked faster lived longer. This is an association; the test alone does not show any disease. Some experts also describe walking speed as a “vital sign”, like pulse and blood pressure.
